summary: Frontend-only retest of BookingDetailsSheet round-trip fix (Pro dispatcher, 390x844 viewport). PASS: Round-trip booking ee8c4a98 opened from /dispatch ('Toutes' filter) AND from the dashboard 'Courses récentes' shows 'Départ (aller) sam. 24 octobre 2026 à 18:00' + bold 'Retour ven. 30 octobre 2026 à 09:00' (fontWeight 900, 15px), Type 'Aller-retour'. One-way booking d47fec18 shows 'Date & heure' with no Retour row. Simulated through intercepted /api/pro/* responses: return_at=null on a round trip shows 'Retour —' with no crash. flight_number='AF1234' shows a 'Vol' row. Empty train_number '' is hidden. tracking_url shows a truncated 'Suivi' row with a chevron that can be tapped (tabindex=0, cursor pointer). trip_type undefined shows 'Date & heure', no Retour, Type '—'. train_number 'TGV 6201' shows a 'Train' row. No regressions: Client section (Nom/Email/Téléphone + Appeler/Email buttons), Paiement breakdown + Statut 'En attente', 'Attribuer un chauffeur' CTA for pending bookings. Driver regressions also pass: the video splash shows at boot and is removed after about 4s, the driver home has 4 tabs (Carte/Missions/Historique/Menu), and the subscription screen shows Actif, 50,00 € / mois and Gérer + Résilier.

ui_bugs.issue: Backend returns payment_method='card_onboard' and the UI shows the raw key 'card_onboard' because paymentMethodLabel() has no case for it. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/BookingDetailsSheet.tsx:58

vehicle_type holds a UUID (e.g. '9b8beb61-6cfe-4576-9af7-6308764387fd'), and that raw ID is shown to the dispatcher instead of a category name. Resolve it against /pro/vehicles or the vehicle categories. Reference: BookingDetailsSheet.tsx:282

issues: Tappable KeyRows (Email, Téléphone, Suivi) are about 30px tall, below the 44px minimum touch target. Add minHeight 44 or hitSlop.
Close X button is 32x32 (hitSlop 10 makes up for it).

action_items: Add 'card_onboard' (e.g. 'Carte à bord') and other backend payment_method keys to paymentMethodLabel()
Map vehicle_type UUID to a human-readable category name in the Chauffeur & véhicule section
Optional: add testIDs to the sheet (e.g. booking-details-sheet, booking-details-return-row, booking-details-close) and give tappable KeyRows a 44px minimum height
critical_code_review_comments: Round-trip logic is correct: isRoundTrip is computed before the early return, no hooks are called conditionally, and fmtDate(null) returns '—'.
Sheet elements have no testIDs, so the tests had to rely on text selectors.
seed_data_creation: None. Null return_at, optional travel fields and undefined trip_type were simulated with Playwright route interception of GET /api/pro/* only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro dashboard uses GET /api/pro/dashboard (recent_bookings). Dispatch uses /api/pro/bookings + /api/pro/drivers. Card testIDs: booking-card-{id} (dispatch) and dashboard-booking-{id} (dashboard). Round-trip booking ee8c4a98-7e67-4ec5-9f8d-b04f0cc53fd4, one-way booking d47fec18-7dcc-448e-a4c9-c696e7822543. To test edge cases, intercept **/api/pro/** and mutate the JSON.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: the sheet only rendered pickup_at and never read return_at. Fixed by the conditional Retour KeyRow for trip_type 'round_trip'; verified.
